ariadne logo: the Labyrinth of Biology

logo.Rmd

If you’re going to decipher a hidden code from a complex set of different mazes, I’m pretty sure you need a girl’s brain running the show.

― James Dashner, The Maze Runner

Inspired by the legend of Theseus and the Minotaur, the ever-changing (yet reproducible) ariadne logo reflects the variable nature of the Labyrinth of Biology. The emojis found in the labyrinth rooms represent isolated biological entities, which ariadne attempts to connect by weaving a pathway between them.

Everything about the ariadne logo is reproducible and open source! A new labyrinth configuration is generated every Wednesday by the hexSticker script. At the same time, new resource versions are automatically added to the package metadata. Emojis are drawn from a selected subset of the OpenMoji Library based on the calendar date (Groß et al. 2018--2026). The text is styled with the Dancing Font as provided by the Font Library.

There is no single solution to the ariadne logo, but you have until next Wednesday to find all connections between the feature emojis.

References

Groß, Benedikt, Daniel Utz, and The OpenMoji Contributors. 2018--2026. “OpenMoji.” https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19704720.
